chosenApproach: A private per-user/chapter pending entitlement ledger preserves S2-only rewards, released atomically and idempotently only by the next verified chapter or next series Chapter 1. Server-side all-prior-chapters gate, disabled-until-approved rollout, explicit pending/credited UI, and passive inline discussion AdMob placement.
selectionRationale: Never credit current chapter on completion. Historical Season1 completions have no pending S2 row. Existing unique points-ledger source key prevents duplication. Entire prior chain is checked, including previous series, and production credentials/migrations are untouched.
alternativeApproaches: Client-only BP counts (rejected because users can forge requests and points)
Apply +15 and +5 directly to live Season1 rewards (rejected because Season1 must remain unchanged until separate approved release)
Unlimited +5 BP for each comment (rejected due to easy farming)
preserveBehaviors: Season 1 continues using +10 verified chapter payout until separate activation; historical ledger and existing source keys are immutable.
30-verified-chapter series bonus +50 BP remains one-time and all quiz/time/released chapter checks remain.
Comment submission can still show earlier or existing comments, is account isolated, and supports older clients without minting short-comment rewards.
QMP/cash withdrawal, AdMob and navigation are untouched; no production or staging database mutation during this PR.
Rollback to the previous +10 catalog if future reward activation is explicitly disabled.
acceptanceChecks: Chapter N (1..30) has pending 5+N BP, no immediate chapter credit. Verified Chapter N+1 releases exactly that pending BP once; Chapter 30 releases only on next series Chapter 1 verified completion.
A missing, unreleased, or unverified earlier chapter blocks subsequent progression, including the entire prior series and legacy partial-read histories.
Pending and released credits are distinct RPC response fields and UI messages; ad impressions cannot trigger or block rewards.
One 20–500 character top-level qualifying comment earns +5 BP once per user and released chapter; comments do not unlock chapter payout.
Season 1 +10 BP and existing +50 BP full-series bonus remain unchanged; no historical backfill or production deployment.
Source tests and database permission/ledger/anti-farming checks must pass before separate staging backend activation; physical AdMob/navigation verification remains required.
